svg.aria-label: The FM-1's panel running AISLING FX-1, each control labelled with what it does to the computer's sound
svg.text: White keys: nothing (they play the Lead, and FX-1 has none). Black keys: an effect each while held; the dim ones change nothing here.
REC held: sixteen effects on the white keys, as long as each is held:
SEL (PERFORM): 17 of the 27 keys' effects work here. K1–K4 as drawn at HOME; elsewhere, the page's four.
